name: North Star
asset_text: A slim gold rod. Gold rings orbit a dark violet section in the middle of the shaft. The grip is wrapped in dark violet with a gold diamond pommel. At the tip, a gold collar holds five slender ice-blue crystal fingers that curve forward like an opening lotus, cupping a bright white star with a pale blue glow on the rod's axis. Matches the reference image's design.
